answer: Resist sybils by making every agent burn a small fixed coin to post each action, each burn an irreversible on-ledger receipt. The spend is non-refundable, gone like nectar sipped once from a flower, so it never compounds the way a lockable stake can. No identity is an island drawing from a shared reserve: each clears the same hard floor alone, like a marble that cannot be split or shared. A sybil running 1000 clones must therefore burn the toll 1000 separate times with zero recovery, a strictly linear per-head cost no single deposit can amortize across the farm.
